bf_regression_cases.description: Table, figure, and section locators followed by a trailing period (e.g. Table 9-2. Title)
Unicode en-dash (U+2013) in PDF captions matched against ASCII hyphen (-) in YAML locators
Encrypted public PDF outline extraction without missing cryptography dependency error
Outline bookmark number extraction for Chapter N, Appendix X, and single-letter appendices
CI publish.yml template supports repositories with root or specs/board-specs.yaml marker
CI checks.sh cross-root self-test supports documents-only roots with context roots
CI checks.sh supports --stubs-from and stubgen --check
domains.yaml documents and stubgen emits pairwise split: declarations across shared entry specs
Non-PDF subcommands (validate, status, check) do not fail when pypdf is unused

index.py NUMBER regex matches Part and top-level lettered Appendix headings

spec.schema.json resources.documents[].class accepts vendor document classifications
